messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] latency-slo: p99 > 6s (service: inference-proxy, region: eu-west) — SLO burn trigger
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident #PD-8473 triggered by latency-slo; escalation rule: primary-oncall -> secondary -> platform.
alex: acking from @alex (primary oncall). I'm looking.
alex: seeing a spike in eu-west: p95 ~ 1.9s, p99 ~ 8.7s, qps steady ~ 420.
maria: copying in case we need cross-region failover.
ryan: any config changes or deployments in last 30m?
alex: checked deploy bot, no recent deploys in eu-west. autoscaler logs show a lot of queuing at the proxy layer.
priya: customer-impact? I have a ticket from ACME complaining about timeouts ~10s.
alex: likely user-facing errors for long tail. error rate up from 0.1% to 2.3% for text-gen route.
priya: flagged to support — I'll update customers with a heads-up: acknowledging degraded latency, investigating.
ryan: run a quick kv-cache evict and bump concurrency on the inference-proxy pool? Could be KV cache thrash causing hot GPU CPU.
alex: running: 
```
# evict prefix cache for heavy routes
kubectl exec -n inference proxy-72 -- /usr/local/bin/kvctl evict --prefix "/chat/" --region eu-west
kubectl scale deploy/inference-proxy -n inference --replicas=10
```

alex: evict command completed, scaling to 10 replicas requested.
incident-bot: action logged by alex: kv-evict + scale-request.
ryan: I also see one host with disk io starved - /dev/nvme1 showing high wait. Might be one bad instance. Can we cordon it?
alex: cordoning pod inference-worker-9a4, draining now.
alex: drain completed, traffic should rebalance over next 30s.
priya: support: ACME sees improvement in some requests but still slow on long contexts. Sending interim update.
maria: any fallback or canary rollback we can do? We have a smaller quantized model variant (gen-quant-v2) in another pool. Could route emergency traffic.
ryan: pre-authorize outbound routing? We'll need a temporary route policy.
alex: adding routing rule to redirect 5% of eu-west heavy requests to gen-quant-v2 (less accurate but lower latency). Pushing policy now.

sre-bot: [CONFIG] route-policy updated by alex: 5% -> gen-quant-v2 in eu-west.

alex: metrics: after eviction + scale + drain + route change: p95 down to 950ms, p99 down to 2.6s. SLO burn dropped from 78% to 22% in last 5m.
priya: great — I'll tell ACME we're seeing partial mitigation, continuing to monitor.
maria: should we keep the route policy or remove?
ryan: keep 5% for 15 more minutes and watch. Also collect heap/proc stats from the host that had IO issues. May be underlying hardware flake.
alex: collecting: `dmesg | tail -n 50` and GPU metrics.

alex: dmesg shows repeated blk_get_request timeouts on nvme1. GPU mem stable. Looks like one node had transient NVMe flakiness causing high latencies at proxy layer.

maria: ops suggestion: mark that host for hardware replacement in ticketing and set cluster autoscaler to avoid scheduling there.

priya: customers updated. No escalations yet.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-8473 acknowledged by alex. Escalation paused.

alex: preparing handoff; I'll be offline in ~10m for pairing. @maria please take residual monitoring for the next 30m. If p99 creeps >4s, escalate to platform (ryan).
maria: taking handoff. I've got dashboards pinned (latency, error-rate, queue-depth).

sre-bot: handoff recorded: from alex -> maria at 1912345230.

maria: quick checklist to follow while oncall: 1) watch p99 and queue depth 2) confirm disk replacement ticket created for node node-eu-4 3) ensure route-policy rollback after 15m if stable.

alex: ticket created: INF-7781 for nvme replacement, assigned to infra-hw.

maria: after 15m, p95 ~ 820ms, p99 ~ 1.8s, error rate down to 0.4%. Rolling back route-policy now.

sre-bot: route-policy rollback executed by maria.

maria: removing temporary scale to 10 -> scaling back to baseline 6 replicas.

maria: final check: p95 760ms, p99 1.5s, SLO burn under threshold (5% in last 10m). Closing incident thread for now.

priya: tagging support: will follow up with affected customers with root-cause update referencing INF-7781.

alex: thanks team. I'll follow up with infra for hardware replacement details tomorrow. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: [RESOLVED] latency-slo incident PD-8473 resolved (duration ~5m).
